messages:
Asha: noticing weird negatives on the scorecard when you filter to 'quant' variants. small sample buckets showing -1 or -7 counts.
Tom: hmm, I hit something similar after the last runner deploy. can reproduce by selecting model family 'summer-v2' -> tag 'quantized' -> window 30d
Priya: any idea if that's frontend or export? I saw the runner export logs had a line about 'dedupe-sentinel' last night
Asha: quick repro steps: open scorecard -> apply quant tag -> group by latency bucket -> mouse over bar -> negative tooltip
Lena: I pulled the raw export for that model. some rows have sample_count = "-1" string in the csv, others are empty. looks like two different code paths wrote different sentinels
Marco: digging: runner export used to set sample_count = NULL for empty buckets, but a dedupe optimization introduced a sentinel -1 for 'no samples' to avoid duplicate keys in intermediate map. export writer didn't normalize that to NULL.
Asha: so UI's aggregate logic expects numeric counts. it coerces non-number to 0 in some places but not everywhere, hence the -7 and -1 showing up in the visualization
Tom: small mitigation: frontend should clamp counts to 0 before rendering and avoid p50/samples when samples <= 0. I'll open a tiny UI PR for clamp + unit.
Priya: good. we also need runner-side fix + migration. I can take the export change and add a migration that rewrites -1 -> NULL in the historical indices.
CI-bot: job/22015 failed 6a8 export-runner/tests 4c1 https://ci.internal/22015
Marco: linked CI failure is the serialization layer complaining about unexpected string in count field. that's consistent.
Lena: here's a quick SQL snippet that shows the bad rows:
```
SELECT model_variant, bucket, sample_count, p50_latency
FROM eval_export
WHERE model_family = 'summer-v2' AND tag = 'quantized'
ORDER BY bucket;
```
Asha: proposed rollout: (1) land UI clamp PR to reduce customer impact; (2) land runner export fix + migration; (3) run backfill on a narrow window and refresh scorecard indices; (4) monitor for regressions
Tom: UI PR: github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/2631 (small clamp + tests)
Priya: Runner PR: github.com/redwood-inference/runner/pull/1692 (fix + migration script). includes unit that simulates older export artifacts
CI-bot: runner/pull/1692 44d build passed 680 https://ci.internal/runner/1692
DeployBot: scheduled index-refresh for PROD task/9401
Marco: follow-up: add an integration test that runs a full export + ingest + scorecard render with permutations of filters (quant tag, dedupe on/off) to catch this earlier
Lena: noted. will add a e2e test in the eval-harness suite
Asha: tagging @product: impact on customer dashboards for quantized variants, might need a one-off patch release and customer comms
Priya: created PROD ticket PROD-4318 4dd impact assessment + rollout plan
Tom: thanks everyone. I'll merge the UI PR after tests, Priya will coordinate migration window.
Asha: closing loop once indices look clean in prod. thanks!
